record.question: Fish and chips go hand in hand. Identify the parts of speech of the underlined word 'and'.
record.explanation: Answer A: conjunction. And joins fish and chips; conjunction (A). Independent check: “And” links the noun phrases in “fish and chips,” so it is a coordinating conjunction. Reference: https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar/conjunctions. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Exact printed question, choices and required directions/emphasis reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
